text: In both 24000-step N=64 m2-fixed data_seed 0 runs (seeds 22 and 23), layer-1 force peaks near step 6000 (25% of the schedule) and ends 0.04 below the 12000-step endpoint. Does the 24000-step N=128 seed-23 run (run-20261014-070746-d284) also peak early and decline? If so, is the N=64 minus N=128 layer-1 gap at each run's peak larger than the endpoint gap of 0.040?
